business_summary: Sato Shoji Corporation sells iron and steel products, non-ferrous metals, machines, electronic materials, industrial tools, lifestyle goods, precious metals and jewelry, construction materials, and environment-related goods in Japan. The company offers surface-treated steel sheets, cold-rolled steel sheets, pickled steel sheets, hot-rolled steel sheets, steel bars and bar steel, structural carbon steel sheets, structural carbon steel, structural alloy steel and tool steel, as well as construction materials and equipment mainly to the automobile, construction and agricultural machinery, building, electrical machinery, shipbuilding, and mold and die industries. It also sells aluminum, zinc, copper, tin, lead, nickel, magnesium, silicon, manganese, bismuth, copper products, phosphor bronze, extruded products, processed goods using aluminum cutting, CFRP, resin composite products, GMT, non-ferrous metal scrap, hastelloy, inconel and stainless steel, as well as components, including block rings, cast and wrought, die cast, stainless processed, heat exchangers, lost-wax, peripheral equipment, and other products. In addition, the company offers materials for printed circuit board, semiconductor and liquid crystal, electronic components, and automotive related and other products used in mobile phones and household appliances, such as personal computers and digital cameras, sub-materials, equipment and machines related to manufacturing; and machinery and tools products, such as machining tools, forging machine, automation, various machines, cutting tools, and others products. Further, it provides the Martian, DANSK, and Sori Yanagi branded Western crockery and cutlery, precious metals and accessories, as well as tableware and kitchen goods. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 사토쇼지(Sato Shoji Corporation)는 일본 내 철강제품, 비철금속, 기계, 전자재료, 산업공구, 생활용품, 귀금속 및 보석, 건축자재, 환경 관련 상품을 판매하고 있습니다. 당사는 표면처리강판, 냉연강판, 산세강판, 열연강판, 봉봉강, 구조용 탄소강판, 구조용 탄소강, 구조용 합금강 및 공구강을 비롯하여 자동차, 건설 및 농업 기계, 건축, 전기 기계, 조선, 금형 산업을 중심으로 한 건축자재 및 장비를 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 알루미늄, 아연, 구리, 주석, 납, 니켈, 마그네슘, 실리콘, 망간, 비스무트, 구리 제품, 인청동, 압출 제품, 알루미늄 절삭 가공품, CFRP, 수지 복합 제품, GMT, 비철 금속 스크랩, 하스텔로이, 인코넬, 스테인레스 스틸과 블록 링, 주조 및 단조, 다이캐스트, 스테인리스 가공, 열 교환기, 로스트 왁스, 주변 장비 및 기타 제품을 포함한 부품을 판매합니다. 또한, 인쇄회로기판, 반도체용 소재도 제공하고 있습니다.
